The area is fantastic, but the cuisine isn't that terrific!
Sep 2024 • Couples
Let's start by talking about the food. It's abundant and freshly prepared, with a wide variety. The food trays are numerous and continuously replenished, and the drinks are satisfactory. My favorite is the a lager. The cuisine is average, but the space is incredibly open and large. We can sit and dine while watching the street, which is fantastic. Besides, the service staff is quite lovely and friendly, which I really appreciate.

Copenhagen, Denmark198 contributions

Great street food / barbecue in Hanoi
Feb 2023
We came across this place a bit by chance, just saw how busy it was, and how delicious the food looked and decided to try. Happy we did. You choose yourself your food from their fresh counter with all sorts of meats/proteins as well as vegetables. Then they prep it for you and you finish it yourself in a wok-type pan, they have prepped with some nice spices and herbs. The entire experience of sitting on the small plastic stools a few steps from the busy road in Old Quarter Hanoi just adds to the charm and experience. It was fun, tasted great, and was extremely affordable. Can only recommend.
